_doc: Del Mar buildings pass 1 (ledger 0083): OSM's footprints in the lap + 600 m (osm_buildings.provenance.json), classed, heights from OSM building:levels or the shadow on the 2012 NAIP or the class default [invented], through tools/plan_buildings.py. The NAIP is the source track's (tracks/del-mar/source/naip_2012_delmar.png: ca_m_3211706_ne_11_1_20120519, Web Mercator z18 crop, its corners the config's control points; x0 / y0 are those corners in z18 tiles). Buildings off the crop read no roof colour (the planner's 'tan').
_yes_by_area_doc: a fairground, not a suburb: an untagged footprint is a kiosk (under 60 m2), a one-storey office / stall block (under 1,500 m2) or an exhibit hall [invented rule, by the 2012 NAIP: no house roofs among them]

tag_class._doc: the tags TAG_CLASS lacks: building=stable is the barn rows north of the lap (long low gables on the NAIP), building=grandstand the racetrack's grandstand (OSM building:levels 6; flat-roofed, as commercial), building=pavilion an open-sided show-ring roof (left out as a canopy: the pipeline has no open-sided form)

lidar._doc: pass 2 (ledger 0083): roofs and ground MEASURED off USGS 3DEP lidar CA_SanDiegoCo_D24 (flown 2024-11-09; tiles 11SMS475648 and 11SMS476648, Kevin's go 2026-11-06) by tools/lidar_building_heights.py, run on this plan's output without this key; the Grand Stand (osm116794621) stands as its measured tiers. Pass 3 (Kevin 2026-11-07, 'Yes, fetch them'): three tiles more, 11SMS475649 / 476649 / 475647, every footprint on the five; measured on the G10.

roof_forms._doc: pass 4 (ledger 0083; Kevin 2026-11-07: "We can keep moving ahead on the plans"): each roof's form fitted to the 2024 points by tools/lidar_roof_forms.py (extract on the G10 over the five tiles, run on this plan's output without lidar; fit with --stepped osm116794621): flat with its measured parapet, gable, hip, shed, its measured levels as parts, the Grand Stand's slope as a slope; a poor fit stands its median, flagged; the two hillside garages over their downhill ground

roof_colour._doc: pass 4 (ledger 0083): each roof's median NAIP pixel (this plan's image) as one cell of the palette the track's texture_overrides ROOF binds; a roof off the crop keeps its class stand-in

_canopy_posts_doc: pass 3 (ledger 0083): the pavilions and fuel canopies the lidar measured stand as the author's posts form (an open-sided roof on posts); no measured roof, no canopy
_set_in_slope_doc: pass 4b (ledger 0083; Kevin 2026-11-07 "Yes" to the far ground from the lidar): the two hillside garages (osm1353617974, osm1427234829) set into their measured slope: every part at its fitted height over the ring's p10 lidar ground, at that ground's NAVD88 height; walls down to the real ground on every side
